text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Sertraline is an SSRI that inhibits the CYP2D6 enzyme [sertraline:drug_interactions:8], which is involved in metabolizing tramadol [tramadol:clinical_pharmacology:13], potentially increasing tramadol levels. Furthermore, the concomitant use of sertraline and tramadol carries a risk of developing a potentially life-threatening serotonin syndrome because both drugs affect the serotonergic system [sertraline:warnings:9, tramadol:drug_interactions:9]. If concomitant use is warranted, patients should be frequently evaluated, particularly during treatment initiation and dose adjustments [tramadol:drug_interactions:9].
